definitions.explanation: Used to indicate the first in a series of events, locations, or actions. Almost always appears in the pattern ～を{皮切|かわき}りに (starting with ~).

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The nationwide tour begins starting with Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Starting with this store, we plan to open branches in various locations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{起業家|きぎょうか}→起業家：14262_kigyouka⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げた→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧。
examples.english: Starting with his success, young entrepreneurs launched new businesses one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (starting with ~) or ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}りにして. Rarely used as a standalone noun. This expression implies that a first event triggers or leads to a series of similar events.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally referred to the first incision (⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ = skin, {切|き}り = cut) in moxibustion treatment, which was the most painful. From there, it came to mean the beginning of a series.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: starting with ~
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}りにして: starting with ~ (slightly more formal)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮切|かわき}り⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: starting with ~ (written style)
